environment_policy: Web (Python 3.12), TBDub (Python 3.10), voice (Python 3.10) and separator (Python 3.10) use distinct non-overlapping environments. Upscale reuses TBDub CUDA/PyTorch with a vendored RRDBNet; it installs no additional Python packages.
validation_scope: Source references and hashes describe the deployed configuration. Installers perform local import/CUDA/model checks when run; packaging did not rerun a complete installation on a new machine. Runtime receipts and pip-freeze are generated on that machine and are not shipped here.

chatterbox.watermark: Upstream PerTH audio watermark is retained; resemble-perth==1.0.1 is installed.

intentional_upstream_metadata_overrides.resemble-perth: Pinned PyPI 1.0.1 instead of a mutable Git master dependency

notes: Install from the fixed source with --no-deps; upstream metadata conflicts are deliberate. The installer validates CUDA and local checkpoint loading instead of claiming upstream pip check passes.
setuptools==80.9.0 retains pkg_resources used by PerTH 1.0.1.
Only the VC s3gen checkpoint is used; no additional TTS checkpoints are downloaded.

The worker preserves the global sample count, uses bounded context windows and crossfades, and rejects excessive drift; matching duration does not prove identical phoneme timing or perceived speaker/emotion fidelity.

demucs.prefetch: The installer verifies the full checkpoint SHA256 and loads the model, then writes logs/runtime-check.json. The worker requires that receipt, rechecks the file and refuses inference-time downloads.
demucs.audio_io: FFmpeg and SoundFile; avoids torchaudio.load/save and TorchCodec.
demucs.background: Sample-aligned normalized input minus predicted vocals; source-voice residuals can remain.

architecture.note: Adapted architecture is vendored in this repository; no mutable upstream code is fetched during installation. See apps/redub_studio/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt.

real_esrgan.runtime: Reuses TBDub torch==2.9.0+cu128; strict params_ema loading with weights_only=True; CUDA FP16 tiled inference.
real_esrgan.behavior: Conservative per-frame restoration, 70% AI / 30% Lanczos, up to 1080p, no face reconstruction or temporal model. Existing audio packets are copied and verified.
real_esrgan.limitation: Restoration estimates missing detail; inspect face, teeth, mouth movement and frame-to-frame flicker.

tbdub.third_party: Auxiliary models and dependencies retain their individual terms.
